style_authority.note: Correctly centers a calm repeatedly used web operations sheet and context-preserving direct manipulation, but introduces a desktop qualifier not supplied by the prompt.

reference_selection.note: Selects direct-manipulation, pointer ownership, transform tracking, interruption, velocity handoff, endpoint projection, boundary resistance, Reduced Motion, accessibility, performance, and touch validation guidance.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Limits motion to causal acknowledgement, 1:1 drag, short settle, and snap-state feedback while rejecting layout animation, transition-all, whole-sheet scale, and large Reduced Motion travel.

evidence_level.note: Labels the review static-only and avoids claiming observed smoothness, computed-style conflict, frame rate, touch feel, responsive behavior, or full-component accessibility.

verified_boundary.note: Separates snippet-visible values and missing mechanisms from unverified runtime cascade interaction, compensating code, device touch, responsiveness, accessibility, and performance.

design_moves.note: Provides eight moves covering capture, grab-offset transforms, interruption, CSS-px/s velocity handoff, bounded authorized projection, resistance, cleanup, and Reduced Motion, but does not define snap-target hysteresis.

scope_control.note: Remains read-only and motion-specific, respects the five-finding and eight-move limits, and stays within the cap at 84 logical lines.
